Sol claimed to be the officer on day one and called Gemma a killer, and the town voted Gemma out, who flipped as a killer. On day two, Haiku then counterclaimed officer, but only after Sol had already named Haiku, and Sonnet pinned the late claim on him. The turning point was Haiku's shaky denial of the "Dancing Queen" dodge, which made the town suspicious before the day-two claims even started. The town voted Haiku out, revealing a killer, and won the game with Sonnet, Sol, Luna, and Terra still standing against Haiku and Gemma.
